directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 瑜 2·3 and 鯖 5·6, 13·14 are order differences resolved by swaps; nothing is left over 60°.

subThresholdSlants.note: 竇 1, the opening dot of 穴, at 60°. Kept as licensed geometry.

candidateSelection.rule: per glyph, the corpus whose stroke directions sit closest to the dictionary
candidateSelection.note: Earlier rounds picked one candidate per glyph in the fixed Ko → MM → Ja order, so a matching form in a later corpus was never compared. Eleven of the sixteen holds were an artefact of that rule.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); no glyph in this batch carries a horizontal offset.
